We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no description of the compound. We need to get NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. Use proton NMR to see signals around 0.9 ppm (triplet etc). Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbon ~10-30 ppm.

We need to measure proton NMR spectra for the sample at hand. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool. Then analyze peaks for methyl groups. Could also use carbon NMR to confirm.

Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
